additional_wallpaper_dirs.description: Add extra folders to scan for wallpapers using the '+' button.
additional_wallpaper_dirs.label: Additional Wallpaper Directories

animate_selected_card.description: Enable subtle floating and transition animation on the active center card.
animate_selected_card.label: Animate Selected Card

backend_mode.description: Use Noctalia native surface or custom command.
backend_mode.label: Wallpaper Engine

custom_command.description: Command template executed on selection. Use {path} and {output} placeholders.
custom_command.label: Custom Command

include_wallhaven_downloads.description: Automatically scan and display downloaded Wallhaven wallpapers alongside your local collection.
include_wallhaven_downloads.label: Include Wallhaven Downloads in Local Deck

panel_padding_offset.description: Total horizontal/vertical inset subtracted for panel chrome and borders (default 24).
panel_padding_offset.label: Panel Inner Padding Offset (px)

post_hook_command.description: Optional command run after applying a wallpaper (e.g. matugen image "{path}").
post_hook_command.label: Post-Apply Hook

preview_fit.description: How the fullscreen background preview fits the panel (press V in picker to cycle).
preview_fit.label: Background Preview Fit

scale_compensation.description: Controls how monitor HiDPI scaling is applied to panel preview dimensions.
scale_compensation.label: Display Scale Compensation

scan_subdirectories.description: Recursively search folders inside your wallpaper directory for wallpapers.
scan_subdirectories.label: Scan Subdirectories

wallhaven_api_key.description: Optional API key for Wallhaven (unlocks NSFW and personal collections).
wallhaven_api_key.label: Wallhaven API Key

wallhaven_cache_limit_mb.description: Maximum disk space for hi-res previews before older cached previews are automatically pruned (50 to 2000 MB).
wallhaven_cache_limit_mb.label: Wallhaven Preview Cache Limit (MB)

wallhaven_download_dir.description: Directory where applied Wallhaven wallpapers are saved (defaults to ~/Pictures/WallHaven).
wallhaven_download_dir.label: Wallhaven Download Directory

wallhaven_hires_preview.description: Enable full resolution background previews for Wallhaven wallpapers.
wallhaven_hires_preview.label: Hi-Res Wallhaven Preview

wallhaven_purity.description: Purity bitflag (SFW/Sketchy/NSFW, e.g. 100 for SFW only).
wallhaven_purity.label: Wallhaven Purity

wallhaven_sorting.description: Default sorting on Wallhaven (toplist, hot, relevance, views, favorites, random).
wallhaven_sorting.label: Wallhaven Sorting

ui.hints: ← → or wheel browse • Enter apply • F favourite • S sort • R random • V fit • Space peek • Tab source • Esc close
ui.network_unavailable_desc: Could not connect to Wallhaven. Check your internet connection and try again.
ui.no_favorites: No favourites yet. Press 'F' on any card to add it!
